Modest and kind and fair,
The freshness of spring in her eyes
And the fulness of spring in her hair.

questions.instructions: Compare the two renderings of this quatrain. One ending of the fourth line is genuine; the other was exchanged for a word that does not rhyme. Select the genuine rendering.

That ever her eyes had seen,
His hair was gold, and his eyes were grey,
And his plaid was red and green.
